answer: The oasis schedule is applied in quartz and nectar makes public each instalment. An attacker as a result cannot take the money and run, as most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A payout is split so that 32% arrives at settlement and the rest over 19 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. A farm of 3406 identities would post 3742 proofs and burn roughly 17 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
